parts.label: b
hints: The median corresponds to a cumulative frequency of $0.5 \times 100 = 50$, which falls in the interval $25 \le t < 40$.
Interpolate: $\text{Median} = 25 + \frac{50 - 40}{75 - 40} \times 15 = 25 + 4.29 = 29.3\text{ minutes}$.
For $t = 50$, interpolate between $(40, 75)$ and $(60, 93)$: $CF(50) = 75 + 0.5 \times 18 = 84$.
The number of commuters taking more than $50$ minutes is $100 - 84 = 16$.

walkthrough.text:
Locate median position at $CF = 0.5 \times 100 = 50$ between $(25, 40)$ and $(40, 75)$:
$$\text{Median} = 25 + \frac{50 - 40}{75 - 40} \times (40 - 25) = 25 + \frac{10}{35} \times 15 = 25 + \frac{30}{7} \approx 29.3\text{ minutes}$$

Interpolate cumulative frequency at $t = 50$ between $(40, 75)$ and $(60, 93)$:
$$CF(50) = 75 + \frac{50 - 40}{60 - 40} \times (93 - 75) = 75 + \frac{10}{20} \times 18 = 75 + 9 = 84$$

Calculate number of commuters taking more than $50$ minutes:
$$\text{Commuters} = 100 - CF(50) = 100 - 84 = 16$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:

$$CF = 75 + 9 = 84$$

Subtract from 100 for the upper tail:
$$100 - 84 = 16\text{ commuters}$$
